name: Shathra

abilityDetails.Cross-Fight Ability: Saldıran veya savunan şampiyona uygulanabilen ve bir görev içinde birden fazla dövüş boyunca süren yetenek.
abilityDetails.Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

howToPlay: Shathra için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Live And Die For Your Ideals
As an Attacker, Shathra starts each fight with a Regeneration  Passive, healing [2.5 - 5]% of her Base Health for each stack of Vengeance over 4 seconds.
Whenever a Buff on the Opponent expires naturally, Shathra has a [20 - 80]% chance to inflict a personal Vulnerability.
If Shathra is defeated while she has any Vengeance, she gains 1 additional Vengeance.

abilitySections.title: Eternal Soul of Vengeance - Max: 3
content: Shathra starts each Quest with 0 Persistent Vengeance. Start with 2 Vengeance while fighting in Battlegrounds or Duels.
When Shathra defeats an Opponent, she gains 1 Vengeance. Vengeance gained is increased by 1 against Cosmic Champions and #Spider-Verse Heroes.
For each Vengeance, Shathra gains +[704.89] Attack Rating.

abilitySections.title: Astral Wasps
content: Shathra's Light and Medium Attacks inflict 10 to 16 indefinite Astral Eggs onto the Opponent, or 16 to 24 if they are Stunned. Max stacks: 500.
Whenever a Buff on the Opponent expires naturally, inflict 3 to 6 Eggs.
When Shathra activates a Special Attack, all Eggs hatch into 1 indefinite Astral Wasp each. Max stacks: 500.
During Shathra's Special Attacks 1 and 2, the Astral Wasps attack. For each level of the Special Attack, the Opponent receives +[158.76] Energy Damage every second per 10 Wasps.
As a Defender, when the Attacker taps Block, they swat away Wasps, removing 12. If no Wasps are active, Eggs are removed instead.

abilitySections.title: Sacrifice for your Queen
content: Shathra has abilities that can kill her own Astral Wasps. For every 15 Wasps killed, their bodies dissolve into a [99.74] Vulnerability Passive for 12 seconds, paused during Shathra's Heavy and Special Attacks. Max stacks: 35.
Charging a Heavy Attack kills 180 Wasps per second to Power Steal 35% of a Bar of Power from the Opponent, granting 425% of the Power to Shathra. This ability builds up over 0.6 seconds.
This Power Steal is removed when Shathra releases her Heavy Attack, runs out of Wasps, reaches 3 Bars of Power, or the Opponent runs out of Power.
The potency of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery is reduced by 50%, but each rank increases the percentage of Stolen Power Shathra gains by +15% flat, up to 500%.
Shathra's fourth Light Attack kills 30 Wasps to Nullify 1 Buff on the Opponent. This cannot trigger below 30 Wasps.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict a non-stacking 70% Atrophy Passive for 20 seconds. This Atrophy is refreshed when Shathra performs any Special Attack.
This Atrophy cannot have its Ability Accuracy modified by Cosmic Champions, and disables the Stand Your Ground Mastery while active.
The final hit inflicts 300 to 350 Astral Eggs. As a Defender, this becomes 100 to 125 Eggs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, inflict 5 personal Vulnerability Passives. If activated after the first hit of Shathra's Heavy Attack, inflict an additional 10 Vulnerability Passives.
If activated while charging or performing a Heavy Attack, this Special Attack becomes Passively Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: As an Attacker, this Special Attack cannot be activated unless Shathra is charging a Heavy Attack.
Gain a Regeneration Passive, healing 10% of missing Health over 8 seconds. This also recovers 100% of missing Health caused by Energy Damage from damaging effects.
Inflict a Stun Passive for 3.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Divine Wasp-Totems
content: Once per quest, Shathra can consume 1 Vengeance in the Pre-Fight Menu to place a Cross-Fight Wasp-Totem on the next fight. The next #Spider-Verse Hero to enter this fight becomes a Wasp-Totem for the rest of the Quest, gaining the following abilities:
Poison Immunity: Whenever a Poison fails due to Immunity, gain a +10% Fury Passive for 10 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Performing an Evade, Auto-Block, or Miss starts a 5 second timer. If a Special Attack is activated while this timer is active, it becomes Passively Unblockable.
